$comment: Committed regression tolerances for the Linux replay benches. Every bench is a deterministic replay of committed artifacts, so tolerances are 0: any metric moving in the worse direction is a regression that must be reviewed, and any metric moving in the better direction is reported as an improvement. `informational` metrics describe corpus size or honest abstention and never fail a comparison. Metrics not listed here are treated per `unlistedMetricPolicy`.
